### Mastercard Incorporated to Host Conference Call on Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results


July 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-Incorporated-to-Host-Conference-Call-on-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


On Thursday, July 30, 2026, Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) will release its second quarter 2026 financial results. The company will host a conference call to discuss these results at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


The financial results will be posted on the company’s website at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54567349&newsitemid=20260708369638&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=01cf554b7cb8d3e9e3ba6fe0223a14c5) . The company will issue an alert over a news wire when the earnings materials are publicly available, including a link to those documents.


**Conference Call Details:** Toll-free dial-in: 1-888-330-2508
Toll dial-in: 1-240-789-2735
Conference ID: 6451878


A replay of the call will be available for 30 days and can be accessed below:
Toll-free dial-in: 1-800-770-2030
Toll dial-in: 1-609-800-9909
Conference ID: 6451878


A webcast for this call can also be accessed at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54567349&newsitemid=20260708369638&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=2&md5=afb5e1f8b2a20daacc9e7d2a09b8b20d) .


**About Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA),**[www.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mastercard.com&esheet=54567349&newsitemid=20260708369638&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mastercard.com&index=3&md5=f1e45cb52b665208a001fc0a74a2204b) **** Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re building a resilient economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
